title: Deprecation of Container Combine and Move Tag Methods
summary: Google Tag Manager has deprecated the `combine` and `move_tag_id` methods within the containers resource, signaling a shift in how container migrations are handled.
details: Two specific methods in the Tag Manager V2 API have been marked as deprecated: `accounts.containers.combine` and `accounts.containers.move_tag_id`. These methods are typically used for administrative tasks like merging container configurations or relocating tags. Developers using these endpoints for automation or custom migration tools should begin investigating alternative workflows, as these markers usually precede eventual removal from the API surface.
